frontend: retro-run (writes saves as RetroArch does), via work/c64/make-save-x.py: content copied into the run directory
note: Content: the No-Intro PP Summer Games (USA, Europe).nib converted to .g64 by the VICE core itself (its nib_convert writes <savedir>/TEMP/<name>.g64; copied out before retro_deinit deletes it; identical sha1 from all four VICE cores). VICE writes disk changes in place into the attached image (vice_floppy_write_protection defaults to disabled). The .g64 is not filed (it is the whole game); <name>.g64.changes.json lists the changed 256-byte blocks of the image file with the sha1 of the original and modified image. Run with the .nib itself, the same write lands in TEMP/<name>.g64 and is deleted at unload.

rom_source.name: Summer Games (USA, Europe).nib
rom_source.conversion: VICE's own nib_convert (identical output from vice-x64, x64sc, x128, xscpu64), copied out of <savedir>/TEMP with work/msx/retro-run-x --keep-temp

logical_change: decoded sectors 15/6 (the world-record table), 18/0 (BAM) and 18/1 (directory) changed; the decoded sector data is identical in all four VICE cores, the G64 bytes are not (write splice positions)
